Venice was once a fearsome superpower home to secrets, wealth, and treachery; today, scientists use pioneering acoustic imaging technology to discover the city's ancient foundations and reveal how it's still standing.

description:
S08 E08 — Monsters of the Milky Way
The center of the Milky Way is home to strange and deadly phenomena that is difficult to understand; with the help of science, experts reveal how the black hole, the galaxy's core, shapes life on Earth.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E04 — UFO Tech
An exploration into whether breakthroughs such as high-energy lasers, antigravity technology and super-advanced aircraft are the result of human efforts alone or contact with UFOs.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E01 — Nazi UFO Secrets
Evidence reveals the development of secret Nazi weapons not long after an alleged UFO crashed in Germany's Black Forest; UFO experts investigate whether the U.S. government co-opted this technology for its own space and military programs.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E06 — To Catch a UFO
When a U.S. Air Force intercept aircraft chases after a UFO, it vanishes forever without a trace; a new investigation tries to uncover what caused this mysterious disappearance.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E07 — Subterranean Silo Survival
A decommissioned missile launch facility in Kansas remained one of the best kept subterranean military secrets of the Cold War; experts reveal how this abandoned underground complex transformed into a state-of-the-art survival bunker.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E09 — Ireland's Underground Alcatraz
Subterranean military fortresses situated on the southern coast of Ireland have protected against enemy invasion for over 400 years, and now, experts investigate how this powerful stronghold transformed into a brutal and terrifying prison.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E02 — Cincinnati's Secret Caverns
Deep beneath the streets of Cincinnati lies a network of deserted tunnels and caverns that contain a remarkable history of the city's origins, and now, experts investigate to reveal who built this underground labyrinth and why it was abandoned.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E10 — Medieval Maze of Secrets
A forgotten world of ancient underground passages and medieval engineering lies hidden beneath the town of Exeter, England; experts investigate and reveal how this ambitious tunnel system was the result of one of the deadliest epidemics in history.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E08 — Italy's Subterranean Secret
An unprecedented landslide unveils a hidden world beneath a picturesque town in northern Italy, and now experts investigate this vast network of tunnels and passageways that stretch 300 feet underground to reveal the city's subterranean past.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E06 — Buried Lab of the Black Hills
Buried nearly a mile beneath the Black Hills of South Dakota is a cutting-edge laboratory at the forefront of astonishing scientific research; experts reveal advancements engineers achieved more than a century ago that keep it operating today.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E01 — Hotel Bunker of the Apocalypse
The top-secret construction of a massive nuclear bunker remained concealed under a palatial West Virginia hotel for decades; experts reveal how this vast subterranean structure was one of the most closely guarded Cold War secrets in U.S. history.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E02 — Ghosts of the Berlin Wall
Shocking secrets were revealed when the Berlin Wall finally came down.

title: Forbidden History

New investigations into the mysterious life of Jesus Christ reveal the truth behind this history-changing figure; using the latest evidence, experts try to separate fact from fiction.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E03 — Hunt for Nazi Treasure
Experts investigate the fate of billions of dollars in gold and artwork that Adolf Hitler stole during World War II; using brand-new discoveries, the location of the missing Nazi treasure could be located.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E05 — The Dead Sea Scrolls Conspiracy
Experts investigate if there's a conspiracy surrounding the Dead Sea Scrolls, the ancient texts that the Vatican kept top-secret for decades, which could reveal the location of a mysterious tunnel holding billions of dollars of treasure.

title: Forbidden History
description:

James Bond is one of the famous characters in history, and new discoveries reveal there might be a secret truth behind this famous figure; experts team up with a former spy to separate fact from fiction and reveal the secrets of modern espionage.

Investigators reveal the secret history of U.S. presidents and UFOs, from President Franklin D. Roosevelt's knowledge about a UFO battle over Los Angeles to President John F. Kennedy's alleged plan to share extraterrestrial secrets with the Russians.

Native American myths are steeped in the otherworldly, but new evidence and modern-day UFO sightings have experts rethinking these legends and depictions.

When someone picks up a radio distress call from a seven-year-old boy lost alone in the desert, authorities embark on a search-and-rescue mission to find him; as the hunt continues, the case becomes more and more mysterious.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E04 — King Thutmose II Tomb & Secret Saudi Gates
Look inside the lost tomb of King Thutmose II and get new clues about Egypt's pharaohs; dust off stone hunting structures in Saudi Arabia; visit a 1,200-year-old mosque buried in the Negev Desert and inspect a 30-million-year-old predator skull.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
Million Mummy Necropolis and the Enigmatic Horseshoe
From a cemetery in Egypt to ancient bones on a Welsh beach, ancient burial sites illuminate forgotten lives and long-lost cultural shifts.

Ponder the fate of a mummy buried with an anguished look on its face; learn the secret to Sumerian power in a buried Iraqi palace; visit a lost oasis that may rewrite Arabian history; travel New Mexican roads that align with the heavens.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E06 — Forgotten Mongol Soldiers and an Ancient Iraqi Tavern
Inspect a Mongolian mass grave and learn the fate of a platoon of soldiers, then investigate a 5,000-year-old tavern in Iraq; examine an Egyptian scarab that's far from home and ancient tools that show where desert migration routes once lay.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E05 — Drowned Stone Age Fisherman
Scan the skeleton of a drowned Stone Age fisherman in Chile and rediscover a vanished golden age in Egypt's lost city of Aten; ancient Chinese mummies reignite a cultural debate; discover a massive biblical-era moat in Jerusalem.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E01 — The Atacama "Alien" Skeleton
Examine a tiny skeleton in Chile that set off a firestorm of alien speculation; explore a forgotten Silk Road settlement; uncover evidence of a mass sacrifice in northern Peru and visit a multi-faceted military site from the age of the pharaohs.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E08 — Revenge of the Monster Wolf
Footage of a wolf-like creature in the remote wilderness of northern Canada could be evidence of a dire wolf, a prehistoric beast that went extinct at the end of the last Ice Age; experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate if it has returned.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E03 — Neanderthal Bigfoot Attack
A close encounter with an enraged ape-like creature is caught on camera, experts investigate if it's evidence of a once-extinct Neanderthal specimen engineered by a nearby experimental research facility.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E02 — The Exorcist Effect
A boy who can turn his head 180 degrees and face directly behind him resembles infamous accounts of demonic possession from horror films; experts use cutting-edge technology to find out what's giving him this extreme ability.

title: Strange Evidence
description:

A man sees a doctor complaining of agonizing facial pain, and when they investigate, they discover a strange parasitic species living deep in the man's nose; footage of the grisly encounter reveals what happened next.
